concerns.text: FR-004 specifies a baseline TinyLSTM (quantized transformer), but the original idea explicitly requires a comparison to *standard transformer architectures*. The specification omits a standard transformer baseline, leaving the required comparative condition unimplemented.

User Story 2 redefines the baseline as a TinyLSTM (quantized transformer), which changes the research question from comparing brain‑inspired models to standard transformers to comparing them to an LSTM. This drift alters the scientific claim and may invalidate the intended hypothesis test.
